DIAGNOSIS READY: Infant of a mother with non-immune rubella (Congenital Rubella Syndrome).

The history of maternal non-immunity to rubella combined with the infant's prematurity, respiratory support needs, and signs of anemia strongly suggests Congenital Rubella Syndrome. I am requesting images of a fundoscopic exam to look for a "blueberry muffin" rash or retinopathy, and I will order a Rubella IgM test to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Fundoscopy; REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM
